assets.validation: No camera-safe-volume intersection or fighter occlusion in any required scenario.

assets.runtimeRole: Painted eclipse, cloud, and sky composition at background depth.

assets.runtimeRole: Sparse rail fragments and stone accents outside the gameplay center.
assets.validation: Zero central-combat occlusion and no more than four percent edge-gameplay occlusion.

assets.runtimeRole: Deep city silhouette and low-frequency environmental motion.

assets.runtimeRole: Defines matte basalt, aged brass, ash stone, and restrained cloth responses.

assets.runtimeRole: Baked structural light and controlled low-frequency value grouping.
assets.validation: No baked highlight violates contrast masks or VFX safety-region emission caps.

assets.runtimeRole: Flat, invisible receiver for approved fighter contact shadows.
assets.validation: Receiver is planar at Y 0, follows visual floor only, and never feeds root or collision calculations.

assets.runtimeRole: Layered atmospheric perspective outside fighter and VFX corridors.

assets.runtimeRole: Optional eclipse emission and restrained stage rim response.

assets.runtimeRole: Witness seats, rubble, rails, and other collision-independent presentation meshes.
assets.validation: Meshes are excluded from all combat queries and comply with camera and occlusion masks.

assets.runtimeRole: Stage-select, package-browser, and approval preview imagery.
